notes.en:
• Record task criteria and actual verification results; unrun, failed and changed-after-check states stay visible.
• Improve browser input, click readiness and cancellation.
• Opt into independent Git workcopies, review changes and explicitly confirm safe merges. Original accounts, APIs, conversations and permissions remain; updates are manual.
notes.zh-CN:
• 展示任务验收条件和真实测试结果，区分未检查、失败以及检查后再次修改。
• 改善浏览器输入、点击就绪检查与取消处理。
• 可选择独立 Git 工作副本，预览后明确确认合并。保留原有账号、API、会话和权限；更新仍需手动安装。
